# Cmod A7-35T without TM1638: TinyVGA 640x480, two buttons and two LEDs

Board configuration `cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_no_tm1638_claude`. Русская версия: [README_ru.md](README_ru.md).

This is cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude without the TM1638 module: the labs get
the two buttons and the two LEDs of Cmod A7, and there is no seven-segment
display.

The instruction, the drawings and the wiring are those of the main
configuration,
[cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude](../cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude/README.md);
what differs here is in its section [Without
TM1638](../cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude/README.md#without-tm1638). To build
the labs, pick `cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_no_tm1638_claude` in
`./06_choose_another_fpga_board.bash` and build as described there.

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| [board_specific_top.sv](board_specific_top.sv) | Defines `FORCE_NO_INSTANTIATE_TM1638_BOARD_CONTROLLER_MODULE` and includes the top level of cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude |
| [board_specific.xdc](board_specific.xdc) | The same as in cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude |
| [board_specific.tcl](board_specific.tcl) | FPGA part for Vivado |
